description: This file implements the 'unique' operation optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within PyTorch. It includes functions for computing unique elements, their indices, and counts, specifically tailored for the MPS graph execution framework, with support for various configurations like sorted, dimension-based, and consecutive uniqueness.

classes.name: UniqueCachedGraph
classes.description: A class representing cached MPS graph related to the unique operation, holding tensors like input, output, inverse indices, counts, and length tensors.

methods.name: getUniqueKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for the unique operation based on the tensor's dtype, shape, and options.

methods.name: buildUniqueGraph
methods.description: Constructs the MPS graph for performing the unique operation given the input tensor and options.

methods.name: getUniqueGraph
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached graph for the unique operation with specified parameters.

methods.name: runUniqueGraph
methods.description: Executes the cached or newly built MPS graph for the unique operation, populating output tensors.
